name: AutoRecover
description: Represents the automatic recovery features of a workbook.
remarks: Properties for the AutoRecover object determine the path and time interval for backing up all files. Use the AutoRecover property of the Application object to return an AutoRecover object. Use the Path property of the AutoRecover object to set the path for where the AutoRecover file will be saved.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: True if the object is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Time
properties.description: Sets or returns the time interval for the AutoRecover object. Permissible values are integers from 1 to 120 minutes. The default value is 10 minutes. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the complete path to where Microsoft Excel will store the AutoRecover temporary files.
